title.narrative: Consolidating Gains and Scaling-up Malaria Interventions in South Sudan - South Sudan (01-Apr-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: South Sudan, Malaria, Population Services International (PSI HQ)This program has the following goals: To reduce by 50% the 2013 malaria parasite prevalence levels by 2021. To reduce malaria morbidity and mortality by 80% of 2013 levels by 2021. The objectives of this program are: Ensure 80% of health facilities routinely report on core malaria indicators by 2016. Establish malaria emergency preparedness and ensure timely malaria control responses in all communities affected by conflict, natural disaster or epidemics by 2017. To achieve 100% parasitological diagnosis and treatment of all presented malaria cases according to the national guidelines, by 2021. To ensure that 85% of the population at risk are protected by recommended malaria prevention methods, by 2017. To increase to at least 80%, community and health worker knowledge, attitudes and practices on malaria prevention and control by 2019. To strengthen and sustain the management and coordination capacity of the malaria programme at all levels, by 2017
